description_text: About Us: Founded in 2008 in Sydney, Australia, BCR is a global leader and award-winning financial services company with over 15 years of expertise and commitment to the financial services industry. Job Summary: We are looking for motivated and ambitious Sales Interns to join our dynamic team in the financial services industry. This is a fantastic opportunity for individuals looking to gain hands-on experience in financial markets and develop sales skills. Potential for future employment

job_title: 2026/27 CommBank Summer Intern Program: Product Management - Business & Commerce
description_text: Get hands-on with real projects in CommBank’s 10-week Summer Intern Program. Learn, grow, and discover where your career can take you. Make real impact from day one - You won’t just shadow - you’ll shape! Deliver meaningful product solutions and experiences that influence how millions of individuals and businesses bank every day. Learn from the best - You’ll be supported by a dedicated Program Manager and coached by experienced product leaders. Build strong stakeholder management, strategic thinking and commercial acumen as you collaborate with teams across the business. Thrive in our culture - Join a community that celebrates curiosity, creativity, and customer obsession. With wellbeing initiatives, social events, and a team that genuinely cares, you’ll do work that matters and have fun doing it. Do work that matters Imagine shaping the products and experiences that millions of Australians use every day. From how customers save and invest, to how businesses grow and manage their cashflow - our products power everyday financial moments. As a Product Management Summer Intern at CommBank, you’ll connect customer need with execution and end-to-end customer experience, shaping products from idea through to delivery and continuous improvement. Whether you're helping customers build wealth, supporting small businesses to thrive, or re-imagining how banking works in a digital world - you’ll help solve real customer problems and shape better customer experiences. Across your program, you’ll be supported to grow both deep product management capability and strong commercial acumen. You’ll learn how to think strategically, influence stakeholders, and make customer-centred decisions in a complex environment. You’ll have access to: Summer intern masterclasses and workshops Learning across product management strategy, customer immersion, human centred design, risk, and commercial problem-solving Coaching from experienced product leaders A dedicated Program Manager and graduate buddy See yourself in our team Product Managers are responsible for delivering exceptional experiences and value for our customers. It sits at the intersection of customer need, regulatory obligation, and shareholder viability. As a CommBank Product Management Summer Intern, you will learn and grow across five core capability areas: Customer – A deep customer obsession, grounded in understanding user needs and designing intuitive, seamless product experiences. Data – The ability to identify critical data points and translate them into insights that guide product decisions and measure impact. Industry – Subject matter knowledge of the broader market landscape, including competitors, trends, and emerging technologies relevant to the domain. Business – Strong commercial acumen and an understanding of the legal, regulatory, risk, governance, and compliance frameworks that shape product strategy. Product – Expertise in the product itself - its value proposition, functionality, and opportunities for innovation - ensuring it remains competitive, compliant, and aligned to customer and business needs. You’ll bring your curiosity, customer centricity and creative mindset to the team. Our Product Management Summer Intern Programs operate within two dynamic business units: Retail Banking Services and Business Banking. Retail Banking Services (Sydney) – Play a crucial role in implementing valuable changes that directly impact our retail customers and the products they use daily. This includes their savings accounts, home loans, personal loans, credit cards and investment products. Business Banking (Sydney) – Gain direct exposure to the development of new propositions, product lifecycle management and uplifting our customer experiences across areas such as Digital, Payments, Everyday Business Banking, Business Lending or Customer Channels and Data. As a Product Management Summer Intern, you’ll gain insight into how products are shaped from idea through to delivery, including how customer needs, data and design thinking inform product decisions and experiences. The program offers a unique view into how strategic decisions are made and how products evolve to enhance customer experience and financial wellbeing. Throughout the program, you’ll have the opportunity to make a tangible difference in the lives of our customers, contributing to their financial wellbeing while building valuable product management skills in a real-world environment. At the end of your Summer Internship, you may receive a fast-tracked offer into our 2028 Graduate Program, where you can continue to grow your career across a range of product management teams and disciplines. We’re interested in hearing from people who: Are strong communicators who can influence and collaborate with diverse stakeholders Are strategic thinkers who enjoys using data and customer insights to shape recommendations Are curious, customer-obsessed and comfortable with ambiguity Are strong problem solvers with a solutions mindset Are adaptable, agile, and willing to think outside the box If this sounds like you, and you are: A Permanent Resident of Australia (please note, this does not include bridging visas while awaiting permanent residency or 820 visa holders), or Citizen of Australia or New Zealand at the time of your application In your penultimate year of your overall university degree Achieving a minimum credit average across your degree Sydney based, or willing to relocate to Sydney for the program at your own expense Apply now for our Product Management Summer Intern Program and help shape the future of banking! We have a long history of supporting flexible working in its many forms so you can live your best life and do your best work. Most of our teams are in one of our office locations for at least 50% of the month while working from home the rest of the time. Speak to us about how this might work in the team you're joining. Check out https://www.commbank.com.au/earlycareers to find out more about our pathways.

description_text: We're hiring again — follow your passion for cars with a career at the pointy end of the automotive parts industry. Two openings for engineering students: build a real career while you study, with hours that flex around your timetable Become an automotive data subject matter expert with a world leader in automotive data systems Hybrid work, with potential for study and completion bonuses Build the data, product and project management skills to accelerate your career, working for a subsidiary of a Fortune 500 company About Us PARts Australia is a data specialist developing technology and analytics to service the global requirements of the automotive industry. We develop and maintain data stores, e-commerce and web-based software solutions, including cutting-edge SaaS and cloud applications for the global automotive aftermarket and consumers. Our products are used by leading industry players including manufacturers, and are integrated with well-known systems and platforms like eBay and e-commerce system integrators. We're a small but well-supported Australian team backed by global leaders developing great tech in the automotive parts space. We foster a fun, informal and collaborative environment where your input genuinely shapes how the business runs. About the Role We're looking for two engineers to become automotive data subject matter experts — learning our business from the ground up by doing the real customer data work that keeps it running. Your main focus is helping our customers articulate, present and publish auto parts product and fitment data for millions of parts and catalogue records online. That could mean global marketplaces, local outlets, or their own websites here and internationally. You'll work with PARts Data Suppliers (manufacturers and brands like ARB, DBA, Gates, NGK and Ryco) and Data Users (eBay, Automotive Superstore, Repco) to understand and meet their data needs in our system. Each position reports to one of our Product Managers — one supporting our Platform stream, one supporting our Integrations stream — with day-to-day tasking and quality assurance in our broader subject matter expert team. This is not a software development role — we're looking for engineers who love the automotive industry. You will, however, work hands-on with data and software: running SQL-based data tasks, validating outputs, and generally getting involved with our system operations and platform development. What you'll be doing Customer data delivery — analysing what customers need from their data, then scoping, tracking and delivering it. This includes executing Customer Data Requests, bulk data tasks run against the database using prescribed scripts, progressing through our training stages under supervision. Catalogue data — working with product and fitment data across the standards the industry runs on (TecAlliance/TecDoc, ACES/PIES and proprietary formats) and learning how data maps across them. Customer support — helping triage and resolve customer data queries through the PARts Help Desk, handling first-level requests with guidance and escalating the complex ones. Data quality — reviewing data against established thresholds, cross-referencing between standards, and flagging anomalies before they reach a customer. Project coordination — helping supervise data entry resources and tools, and keeping processing and publication workflows on time. Documentation — keeping runbooks and process guides current as workflows evolve, so what you learn stays transferable across the team. Where this leads This internship should ideally lead to a full-time position after study, or continued part-time work while you finish. You'll start close to the operational engine — which is the fastest way to learn this industry properly — and for the right person there's a clear path toward product and data operations management as you build domain depth. About You Ideally a engineering student at year 3+ Demonstrated interest or hobby-level experience in automotive and cars Strong analytical, problem-solving and project management skills Self-motivated and focused on customer outcomes Excellent English communication skills, oral and written Able to work independently or as part of a team Nice to have Experience with databases and data analysis using Excel, SQL or other organised data structures Exposure to the automotive aftermarket parts industry Familiarity with automotive parts cataloguing or data standards (TecDoc, ACES/PIES) Understanding of e-commerce platforms and online marketplace data requirements Experience in team leadership, with aspiration for more What We Offer Yes, we have a ping pong table. Easy-to-get-to central Sydney office and flexible work-from-home options. Flexible start and finish times built around your studies, with full-time work available over holidays and for industry experience. Fun, informal and happy work environment with great people and a genuinely good culture. Start-up team mindset while being part of a global powerhouse. Excellent career growth with potential to travel while developing your experience locally and globally. Remuneration and hourly rate depend on experience and skill set, and may include completion or other incentive bonuses to help pay for your studies - this includes a Women in Engineering scholarship PARts offers for female candidates. We want quality people and are ready to support them. Most importantly, we want the right attitude and a willingness to learn — the rest will take care of itself. How to Apply Please submit your resume, contact details, academic results and any other relevant details via the portal. A short summary of why you'd like to be considered would also help us understand you better. You must be an Australian resident to apply for this position. Due to the expected number of applicants, only shortlisted candidates will receive a direct response.
